answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36243 Country: India Title: Please tell me I have been seeing snakes in my dreams for 8-9 years Question: Please tell me I have been seeing snakes in my dreams for 8-9 years. What does it mean? Please tell me soon and give solution. Answer ID: 36243 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 242/147/D=1433) Seeing snakes in one's dreams is interpreted with enemy. You should be careful. The nafs of man is his greatest enemy that always accompanies him. It always prompts to evils and incites to commit sins, and allures towards lust and desires. You should take care of it in the way that you always follow Shariah rules and try to keep yourself away from evil deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
